root_causes: Legacy quiet-hours handling asks for hours even when the person supplied them; the text turn never updates the existing owned alert row.
Daily job reports use now instead of the same quiet-end schedule already used by instant job alerts.
fix: A direct quiet-hours setting/query is handled before either brain or stale thread prompts, after host controls.
